chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukufunda itheyibhile. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (indawo yokungathathi cala). Kude kube sesi sithuba i-H+ nganye ifakelwa yi-Na+, ngoko isiphumo siyahlala sihleli.
Inyathelo 2: Kwi-150 mL i-NaOH inika i-Na+ 15 mmol kunye ne-OH- 15 mmol. I-10 mmol ye-OH- isabela ne-10 mmol ye-H+, kushiyeke i-OH- 5 mmol. Ii-ion: Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5, umlinganiselo 3 : 2 : 1, iyonke 30 mmol.
Inyathelo 3: Ii-ion ngaphambi kokuxuba = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Umlinganiselo = 30/50 = 3/5.
Iimpendulo: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-OH- = 15 ihoya ukungathathi cala; i-5/3 iphendula umlinganiselo; i-3/4 ibala ii-ion ngaphambi kokuxuba njenge-40.)
